settings.heading: For the birthday you remembered late
settings.body: One box, eight pieces, packed by hand in Melbourne and sent with your message printed on the card. Order before the cut-off on a business day and it leaves the studio that afternoon.
settings.image_alt: The Signature Sleep Box tied with an oxblood ribbon, seen from above on a powder blue ground

settings.heading: Why it works as a birthday gift
settings.body: It does not need a size, it does not need to match anything they own, and it does not look like it was bought in a hurry even when it was. The card is written in your words, so the thought lands before the box is open.

settings.heading: Leaving it late
settings.body: This is the common case and we have built for it. Order before the cut-off on a business day and the box is packed and dispatched the same afternoon. If you are in Melbourne you can collect from the studio by appointment.

settings.heading: How long it takes
settings.fallback: Delivery estimates are being confirmed with Australia Post and will appear here before launch.

settings.heading: What to write on the card
settings.body: Short beats clever. A name, one specific thing, and your own name at the end. If you are stuck: Happy birthday. Take the morning off for once. Love R.
